description: This file defines a report generation module for holiday summaries in an Odoo (OpenERP) system, including functions for date calculations, XML report creation, and a report class.

classes.name: report_custom
classes.description: A custom report class for generating holiday summary XML reports in Odoo.

methods.name: create_xml
methods.description: Generates an XML report for holiday summaries based on input data, including date calculations, legend and employee data processing, and XML assembly.
